title: Inspect HTTP Request with Python
description: Send a simple GET request to your own local practice app and inspect its response.
code:
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

req = Request('http://127.0.0.1:8000/', headers={'User-Agent': 'CyberLabPro-Training'})
with urlopen(req, timeout=3) as response:
    print('Status:', response.status)
    print('Content-Type:', response.headers.get('Content-Type'))

title: Send JSON to Your Local API
description: Send a JSON request to an API endpoint you own.
code:
import json
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

payload = json.dumps({'name': 'training-item'}).encode()
req = Request('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/demo', data=payload,
              headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
with urlopen(req, timeout=3) as response:
    print(response.status, response.read().decode())

title: Check Content Type of Local Endpoint

title: Parse a URL into Components
description: Understand scheme, host, path and query components.
code:
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, parse_qs

url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/search?q=training&page=1'
p = urlsplit(url)
print('Scheme:', p.scheme)
print('Host:', p.netloc)
print('Path:', p.path)
print('Query:', parse_qs(p.query))

title: Review CORS Headers on Local API
description: Inspect CORS response headers on your own API; do not assume a missing header is automatically a vulnerability.
code:
from urllib.request import urlopen

with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/demo', timeout=3) as r:
    for name in ['Access-Control-Allow-Origin', 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials', 'Vary']:
        print(name, ':', r.headers.get(name, 'not present'))

title: Send a Local OPTIONS Preflight
description: Inspect the preflight response from your own API.
code:
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen

req = Request('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/demo', method='OPTIONS',
              headers={'Origin': 'http://localhost:3000',
                       'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'POST'})
try:
    with urlopen(req, timeout=3) as r:
        print(r.status, dict(r.headers))
except Exception as exc:
    print('Review local preflight response:', exc)

title: Paginate API Results Safely
description: Clamp pagination inputs to prevent unbounded result requests.
code:
def pagination(page, size):
    page = max(1, min(int(page), 10_000))
    size = max(1, min(int(size), 100))
    return page, size

print(pagination('1', '25'))

title: Check TLS Certificate Hostname
description: Use the system TLS verifier to confirm the certificate matches your authorized lab hostname.
code:
import ssl, socket

host = 'localhost'
context = ssl.create_default_context()
try:
    with socket.create_connection((host, 443), timeout=3) as sock:
        with context.wrap_socket(sock, server_hostname=host) as tls:
            print('Verified TLS:', tls.version())
except Exception as exc:
    print('TLS check failed:', exc)
